name: KB article update — Ground Control ECLSS

body.title: CO2 Scrubber Cartridge Replacement — In-Flight Procedure
body.body:
## Purpose
Replace the CDRA (Carbon Dioxide Removal Assembly) sorbent cartridge during translunar or lunar surface operations.

## Prerequisites
- Replacement cartridge stowed in locker LB-12
- CO2 partial pressure > 5.3 mmHg or scrubber cycle count > 72 hours
- CAPCOM and ECLSS officer notified

## Steps
1. Don gloves. Cartridge contains desiccant — avoid contact with eyes.
2. Power down CDRA via panel switch ECLSS-7.
3. Wait 3 minutes for depressurization of sorbent bed.
4. Remove locking ring (quarter-turn counterclockwise) and extract spent cartridge.
5. Insert new cartridge, seat fully, re-engage locking ring.
6. Power CDRA back on; verify green status light within 30 seconds.
7. Log replacement time and cartridge serial number in IFS.

## Caution
Do not operate cabin without active CDRA for more than 20 minutes. If CDRA fails to start, switch to LiOH backup canisters per contingency procedure LS-C4.

## References
- ECLSS Operations Handbook, Rev 7, Section 3.2
- LiOH Contingency Procedure LS-C4
